subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion Pricing — volume step-ups & blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Gupta <sara@acmehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Next Steps — Renewal & expansion (volume step-ups)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to chat this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

What I heard:
- Current monthly generation volume: ~10M tokens (mostly customer-facing LLM routes).
- Near-term roadmap: adding 2 new model routes for summarization and context-enrichment; expect a stepped increase to ~30-40M tokens over the next 9-12 months as pilots roll into production.
- Top priorities: predictable unit economics, keeping latency under 300ms p95 for web routes, and an easy path to add new routes without renegotiating the whole contract.

Ask from us to price properly:
1) Can you send a recent export of monthly token usage by route (even a single CSV is fine) — this helps us propose blended rates and step-up tiers.
2) If you have a target budget range for the renewal/expansion window, share a monthly or annual figure so we can align to your constraints.

Proposed next steps:
- You: send the usage export (CSV) and confirm an internal budget range.
- Us: we’ll provide a renewal + expansion proposal with volume tiers, blended rates, and an example step-up schedule.
- Optional: Rafael (cc’d) can run a quick performance baseline on the sample model routes once we have the token breakdown.

I’ve attached a stub for the usage export request (Acme_Q1_usage_export.csv) — feel free to reply to this thread with the file. I’ll aim to get a first proposal over within 3 business days after we receive the CSV.

Thanks again — excited to help you scale.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — attached the export you requested (Acme_Q1_usage_export.csv). A few notes from our side:

- Current baseline: ~10M gen tokens/month across two routes (chat + transactional notifications).
- Planned additions: 2 pilot routes (summarization, context-enrichment) rolling over Q3; we expect a steady ramp to ~35M tokens/month within 9-12 months if pilot success metrics are met.
- Budget: expect to allocate roughly $20k–$45k/month for API consumption during the renewal term, with potential for higher spend if pilot expands faster.
- Target unit economics: we’re aiming for a blended target in the neighborhood of $600–1,000 per 1M tokens depending on model mix (we know higher-capacity models cost more).

Please include an example step-up schedule with blended rates for the following buckets: 0–10M, 10–30M, 30–60M. Also include guidance for adding new routes (how they affect blended rates) and any pilot credits or introductory pricing you can offer for the first 3 months.

Tom and I are available next Wednesday for a 30m follow-up if that helps.

Thanks,
Sara

sara@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Gupta <sara@acmehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion Pricing — proposed tiers & blended rates

Hi Sara / Tom —

Appreciate the export — that’s exactly what we needed. Draft proposal summary is below; I’ve attached a PDF with the full worked examples (Redwood_renewal_proposal_v3.pdf).

High-level proposed pricing (blended example):
- Tier A (0–10M/month): list price $1,200 per 1M tokens (pilot/initial tier).
- Tier B (10–30M/month): blended target $850 per 1M tokens (applies to incremental volume in this band).
- Tier C (30–60M/month): blended target $650 per 1M tokens (applies to incremental volume in this band).

Example blended calculation (month with 35M tokens):
- First 10M @ $1,200 = $12,000
- Next 20M @ $850 = $17,000
- Remaining 5M @ $650 = $3,250
- Blended total = $32,250 -> blended $921 per 1M tokens

Notes / optional levers:
- Committed spend: 10% discount available on the blended total for a 12-month committed volume contract.
- New routes/models: we treat new production routes as incremental volume to the relevant tier; if a model route requires a materially higher-cost model (e.g., L2 compliance model), we can price it as a separate add-on line with its own tiering.
- Pilot credits: we can offer a 3-month pilot credit equivalent to 2M tokens/mo free for the first 3 months (applied as a one-time credit on month-end invoice).
- Performance: Rafael can schedule a baseline perf test for the two pilot routes; we’ll dimension GPU capacity and expected p95 latency before finalizing SLA language.

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, I’ll turn this into a formal renewal + amendment with the step-up schedule and have legal/finance review for committed terms. Can we confirm a follow-up call on Wed 25 Mar at 11am PT?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_renewal_proposal_v3.pdf
